fact: Aspect/face of the documented Walrus Glacier line

The row's aspect W, face 'West Ridge' and climbing_route[] (Pt. 8373 gully, final south/west ridge) all describe the scramble, while beta describes the Walrus Glacier and says the glacier-free line 'is not the line documented here'. Proposed: either split into a 'Southwest Ridge' scramble row (aspect W/SW, keep climbing_route) and a 'Walrus Glacier' row (aspect NE/E, keep beta), or rename this row to the scramble and rewrite beta to it with the glacier kept as an approach_variants alternative. fact: Whether the approach goes via Prusik Pass (beta) or deliberately avoids it (approach / baseFinding)

fact: Where the climbers' path leaves the maintained trail (Park Creek Pass traverse vs the ~4,100 ft washout on the Park Creek trail)
evidence: STRUCTURAL: two sources now state the low start explicitly and neither describes a traverse from the pass. The peak's route page: from Park Creek Camp (2,280 ft) follow the Park Creek trail ~2 mi to a creek-crossing camp, then ~2 mi more to a large washout/rockslide of whitish rock; the boot path to Storm King (and Goode) starts about five minutes up-trail beyond it, marked by a small cairn; the Thunder Creek approach crosses Park Creek Pass, descends into Park Creek and climbs back up southeast then east. The club route page: from Two Mile Camp (3,400 ft) ascend ~2 mi to ~4,100 ft, cross a large washout, look for a small cairn a few hundred yards on and climb the burned ridge, trending climber's left through heather and game trails to cairned Class 2-3 ground and the basin below Goode at 7,400 ft. The row's own coordinates also put the peak and the rib camp EAST of the pass, not west. What should change: approach (sentence 'From Park Creek Pass, leave the maintained trail and traverse cross-country west/southwest ... roughly a mile to reach the cirque'), approach_variants[0].notes (same paragraph), waypoints[3].directions ('Leave the maintained trail at the pass and traverse ... west/southwest') and descent_text ('reverse the cross-country traverse east back to Park Creek Pass') should describe crossing the pass, descending the Park Creek trail to the ~4,100 ft washout and climbing the ridge to the 7,400 ft basin (matching itinerary day 2 and timing.sectionBreakdown[1]); the waypoint list needs a washout/boot-path junction pin and the rib camp's distMi (21, only 1.4 mi past the pass) re-measured, which needs a pin addition and distances no source states. That exceeds the patch format, so no patch.
